component.name: Materix
component.summary: Multi-account Matrix messenger with end-to-end encryption

description.p: Materix is a multi-account Matrix client for desktop and the web that feels like a mainstream messenger (Signal, Telegram, WhatsApp) while staying a full Matrix client for power users. End-to-end encryption is on by default for direct messages and new private rooms.

ul.li: Log into several Matrix accounts and homeservers at once, with one unified chat list
End-to-end encryption (Rust crypto), device and user verification, and secure key backup
Rich messages: Markdown, images, video, files, voice messages, polls, and location sharing
Threads expanded inline, replies, edits, reactions, read receipts, and typing indicators
1:1 voice and video calls with an encryption and peer-to-peer / relay status indicator
Spaces, room settings and roles, moderation tools, and a public-room directory browser
Send-time image editor that strips EXIF/GPS metadata and can censor regions before sending

screenshot.caption: Unified chat list and an encrypted conversation
